nodes.description: Public token name string stored in contract storage.
Public token symbol string stored in contract storage.
Public uint8 token decimals value.
Total token supply, set to 100000000000 in the constructor.
Mapping of holder address to token balance; written by constructor, transfer and transferFrom.
Nested mapping owner=>spender=>amount allowance; written by approve and transferFrom.
Constructor: sets name, symbol, decimals, _totalSupply and credits the deployer with the whole supply.
View returning _totalSupply minus balances[address(0)]; performs an unchecked subtraction.
View returning the balance of a given tokenOwner.
View returning the remaining allowance of spender for tokenOwner.
Sets allowed[msg.sender][spender] = tokens and emits Approval; no validation of spender or amount.
Debits balances[msg.sender] and credits balances[to] using safeSub/safeAdd, emits Transfer.
Debits balances[from] and the caller allowance, credits balances[to]; relies only on safeSub underflow checks for allowance.
Payable fallback that unconditionally reverts, rejecting all plain ether transfers.
Pure addition helper performing a + b guarded by require(c >= a).
Pure subtraction helper performing a - b guarded by require(b <= a).
Pure multiplication helper performing a * b guarded by require(a == 0 || c / a == b).
Pure division helper performing a / b guarded by require(b > 0).
Caller-controlled address used as balance owner, allowance owner and self-allowance key.
Unchecked uint256 subtraction _totalSupply - balances[address(0)] inside totalSupply().
Arithmetic c = a + b; relies on the require(c >= a) guard to prevent overflow.
Arithmetic c = a - b; relies on the require(b <= a) guard to prevent underflow.
Arithmetic c = a * b; relies on the division-based guard to prevent overflow.
Arithmetic c = a / b; relies on require(b > 0) to prevent division by zero.

Input address used as the allowance spender in allowance.

Recipient address credited in transfer.
Amount debited from msg.sender and credited to the recipient in transfer.
Owner address debited in transferFrom without any allowance-owner validation.
Recipient address credited in transferFrom.
Amount debited from from and from the caller allowance in transferFrom.

Second operand of the safe multiplication helper.
Dividend operand of the safe division helper.
Divisor operand of the safe division helper, must be greater than zero.
Return local holding the result of the guarded addition.
Return local holding the result of the guarded subtraction.

Return local holding the result of the guarded division.

edges.reason: Constructor assigns the token name literal to the name state variable.
Constructor assigns the token symbol literal to the symbol state variable.
Constructor assigns zero to the decimals state variable.
Constructor initialises _totalSupply with 100000000000.
Constructor mints the entire supply into balances of the deployer.
msg.sender is used as the mapping key when writing balances in constructor, transfer and transferFrom.
msg.sender indexes the allowed mapping as owner in approve and as spender in transferFrom.
approve authorises spending of msg.sender funds with no restriction on the caller or spender.
transfer debits msg.sender balances directly, so the caller identity defines the fund source.
transferFrom reads the allowance of msg.sender over an attacker-supplied from address without validating the caller.
totalSupply reads the _totalSupply state variable.
totalSupply performs an unchecked subtraction of balances[address(0)] from _totalSupply.
balanceOf reads balances[tokenOwner] to build its return value.
allowance reads allowed[tokenOwner][spender].
approve writes the tokens amount into allowed[msg.sender][spender].
transfer reads and writes both the sender and recipient balances.
transferFrom reads and writes balances[from] and balances[to].
transferFrom debits allowed[from][msg.sender] after the token movement.
transfer calls safeSub to debit the sender balance.
transfer calls safeAdd to credit the recipient balance.
transferFrom calls safeSub twice, on the from balance and on the caller allowance.
transferFrom calls safeAdd to credit the recipient balance.
safeAdd executes the guarded addition c = a + b.
safeSub executes the guarded subtraction c = a - b.
safeMul executes the guarded multiplication c = a * b.
safeDiv executes the guarded division c = a / b.
tokenOwner parameter flows into the balances lookup of balanceOf.
tokenOwner parameter indexes the allowed mapping in allowance.
spender parameter indexes the allowed mapping entry in allowance.
spender parameter becomes the approved spender key in approve.
tokens parameter is stored as the allowance value in approve.
to parameter receives the credited balance in transfer.
tokens parameter drives the safeSub/safeAdd amounts in transfer.
from parameter selects the debited balance and allowance owner in transferFrom.
to parameter receives the credited balance in transferFrom.
tokens parameter is subtracted from both the balance and the allowance in transferFrom.
First safeAdd operand feeds the addition operation.
Second safeAdd operand feeds the addition operation.
Minuend operand feeds the safeSub subtraction.
Subtrahend operand feeds the safeSub subtraction.
First safeMul operand feeds the multiplication.
Second safeMul operand feeds the multiplication.
Dividend operand feeds the safeDiv division.
Divisor operand feeds the safeDiv division and its non-zero guard.
Local c carries the result of the guarded addition out of safeAdd.
Local c carries the result of the guarded subtraction out of safeSub.
Local c carries the result of the guarded multiplication out of safeMul.
Local c carries the result of the guarded division out of safeDiv.
Named return local balance holds the value produced by balanceOf.
Named return local remaining holds the value produced by allowance.
Named return local success is set to true by approve.
Named return local success is set to true by transfer.
Named return local success is set to true by transferFrom.
